round-1 blocker: undo marker.reason: Undo-DesktopIconOrganization (DesktopIconManager.ps1:2035-2043) writes UndoneAt and rewrites the manifest only when no entry failed. Otherwise it prints each failure and says the run stays open. The default undo then picks the same run again (newest with an empty UndoneAt), and the explicit -DesktopIconUndoManifest path no longer stops at 'Already undone'. Replay is safe: move/displace only when Destination exists and Source is free, copy/link only when present, the link is skipped while its category folder is non-empty, and mkdir is removed only when empty. Reverse order restores a replace pair correctly (move back first, then the displaced original).

round-1 blocker: string path append.reason: Get-DesktopShortcutClassification:1083 uses Join-Path $Global:DESKTOP_BACKUP_DIR ''. On PS 5.1 this returns 'D:\.dev_win10\.desktopIcons\' (re-verified). A grep of the file for '+ quote', 'quote +' and '$var\' patterns finds no path string appends.

same-destination collisions (was non-blo.reason: Resolve-DesktopPlanCollisions (1297-1346) keeps the newest item per <Category>\<name> (strict -gt, so ties go to scan order). Identical items follow the winner and differing items become conflicts. Get-DesktopPlacementDecision (1482-1522) displaces an existing different file only when the item is strictly newer. It returns unchanged for an identical copy-mode item and duplicate (desktop file to state\displaced\<runId>, recorded as displace) for an identical move-mode item, and a refile onto an existing name is always a conflict. Traced cases: user/Public differing Chrome copies, identical move duplicates, and a refile colliding with a desktop item (either one newer). Each converges after one run, and the second run produces no records, so the copy-mode ping-pong is gone.

IconExtractor -LiteralPath (was non-bloc.reason: IconExtractor.ps1:114 Get-Item -LiteralPath $targetPath. The .lnk/.exe checks are case-insensitive, and Test-Path uses -LiteralPath.

issues.defect: Preview can diverge from the real run in two multi-item cases. (a) An identical copy-mode follower whose destination the winner just placed gets the preview label 'copy (duplicate)', but the real run leaves it unchanged. (b) When the winner is a 'replace', followers are compared with the old filed file and preview shows replace or kept, but the real run treats them as duplicate or unchanged. Preview also does not predict a mkdir or link, so it prints 'Nothing to move' when the real run would only recreate a missing <Category>.lnk. The real run stays correct and idempotent.
issues.fix: In preview, keep a map from each placed destination to the winner's Info. Decide followers against that map: copy mode is unchanged and move mode is a duplicate. Report a missing category link as '[preview] link'.
